units.$description: Product units: product components for every surface (chat, task graph, dashboard). References only lower tiers.

open.why: Tiers were assigned from source folders and names. 54 product-specific components were moved here from tiers 3 and 4 (movedFromTier). Every placement still needs a check.
No inventory entry. Decided: Glass Card, 19px blur, no tone glow; answers inset 19px both sides (base.space.px-19); 24px label pad on the title axis.
Header layout and avatar sizes are decided but belong to tier 6 (regions), outside this catalog.

composer-root.$description: Compose a thread message and coordinate context, agent settings, reply format, dictation, live conversation and send/stop actions.

constraints: Pinned model and Pinned reply require Multi.
Set density explicitly. Available width never selects a density.
Reserve dock clearance when closed. Only model and reply use the dock. Open Add separately at its trigger. Flip the compact picker above when viewport space requires it.
Grow from one to eight lines, then scroll. Figma demonstrates short and expanded examples.
Single agent omits the agent table. In Multi, the model table owns identity, model, reasoning and permission. The reply table owns identity and reply format.
Unavailable controls stay visible, use the disabled treatment and reject interactions.
Use current product colour roles, Caelum Sans for UI and a rounded neutral edge.
